description: C6: FlightIntegrator thermal integration on PhysProf-S, logged every physics frame (after the frame's FixedUpdate + physics step) for the root probe and four other parts (first Rockomax32.BW, liquidEngineMainsail.v2, liquidEngine2, pointyNoseConeB). Cases: pad = parked on the KSC launch pad right after load (engines off, 500 frames); orbit = FlightGlobals.SetShipOrbit to a 100 km circular equatorial Kerbin orbit after the C10 ascent (engines off, 1000 frames); reentry = SetShipOrbit to PeA 25 km / ApA 500 km, placed at 80 km altitude descending (1500 frames or until the vessel is destroyed).
oracles: FlightIntegrator.UpdateThermodynamics and friends (CalculateSunBodyFlux, CalculateConstantsAtmosphere, convection/radiation/conduction per PartThermalData)

provenance.reentry_orbit: ecc=0.27536231884057971 sma=862500 mna=5.76497577275962 (radians, epoch=UT at SetShipOrbit)
provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
